description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeePictureDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup procedures, test methods for saving employee pictures and retrieving them by employee number, and uses traits and external classes related to ORM and entities.
external_files: yaml file referenced in fixture path

classes.name: EmployeePictureDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing EmployeePictureDao methods, including saving and retrieving employee pictures, within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, creating an instance of EmployeePictureDao and populating test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeePicture
methods.description: Tests the process of saving an EmpPicture entity associated with an Employee, then verifies the saved data.

methods.name: testGetEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Tests retrieving employee pictures by employee number and checks for correct handling of existing and non-existing records.
